title: Cathode Q3 2026 Price Review
gist: Benchmark Minerals reports all cathode active material prices fell in Q3 2026, led by LCO (-16% to RMB 327,500/t), as cobalt and lithium feedstock weakened and the usual Sept-Oct restocking failed to appear. LFP CAM producers are squeezed by rising phosphoric acid and ferrous phosphate costs, and Benchmark expects lithium to rise in Q4 on China VAT-rebate frontloading.

insights.claim: In Q3 2026 LCO cathode prices (DDP China) fell 16% to RMB 327,500/tonne, NCM622 fell 11.2% to RMB 166,500/tonne and LFP fell 7.8% to RMB 56,000/tonne, with every cathode chemistry declining on lower raw material prices.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: A broad cathode price slide compresses producer revenue and favours buyers; LCO is the weakest segment.
insights.quote: LCO (lithium cobalt oxide) prices (DDP China) clocked the steepest drop, falling 16% to RMB 327,500/tonne (USD 48,798).
insights.locator: Prices of all chemistries of cathode active material fell

insights.claim: The quarter's declines were driven mainly by cobalt bearishness feeding through feedstock prices into cobalt-containing cathode active material, extending the softening seen at the end of Q2.
insights.speaker: Frederick Bloomfield
insights.so_what: Cobalt price direction is the main swing factor for LCO and NCM cathode pricing near term.
insights.quote: This quarter has been almost entirely characterised by cobalt bearishness weighing on feedstock prices and thus lowering the price of cobalt-containing CAM.
insights.locator: Q3 extended the broad cathode softening

insights.claim: LCO cathode prices fell faster than other nickel-based grades because raw material weakness was compounded by weak portables demand and substitution toward NCM.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Consumer-electronics demand is not providing support for LCO, hinting at further structural share loss to NCM.
insights.locator: Falling LCO CAM prices were compounded

insights.claim: Within nickel-based chemistries mid-nickel cathode fell most and low-nickel least, as lower lithium and cobalt input costs, ample cell supply and ad hoc procurement weighed on prices.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Nickel-grade differentiation shows the price pressure is concentrated in mid-nickel grades.
insights.locator: NCM and NCA grades fell less sharply

insights.claim: The seasonal September-October restocking uptick in cathode prices did not materialise in 2026, and underwhelming downstream demand, especially from domestic Chinese EV makers, added downward pressure.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Missing seasonal restocking is a negative demand signal for Chinese EV battery supply chains.
insights.quote: The usual uptick in prices during the seasonal restocking across September-October did not materialise

insights.claim: NCM811's price decline decelerated late in Q3 on support from overseas EV demand, while grades more common in Chinese EVs kept falling, showing a demand split between export and domestic EV markets.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Ex-China EV demand is currently stronger than domestic demand for high-nickel cathode.
insights.locator: This was evidenced towards the end of the quarter

themes.theme: LFP cost squeeze and margin divergence

insights.claim: LFP cathode prices fell during Q3 despite robust demand because lithium carbonate dropped 20.8% q-o-q and high utilisation as LFP CAM output ramped created ample supply.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: LFP oversupply plus weak lithium leaves producers as price takers despite strong end demand.
insights.locator: LFP CAM prices fell significantly during Q3

insights.claim: Purified phosphoric acid and ferrous phosphate prices rose since June 2026 on shrinking inventories, limited spot volumes and sulphur supply disruptions, with Benchmark's anhydrous ferrous phosphate grade up 4.6% over the quarter.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Input-cost inflation in LFP's phosphate chain is eroding CAM producer margins even as selling prices fall.

insights.claim: Hunan Yuneng, a major Chinese LFP CAM producer, announced a price increase across its LFP range in July citing geopolitical fluctuations and supply chain disruptions, and Benchmark LFP CAM prices ticked up late in the quarter.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Producer-led price hikes show margin stress and may mark a turning point for LFP cathode prices.

insights.claim: Some Chinese Tier 1 battery makers have begun to put purified phosphoric acid directly into cathode price negotiation formulae after PPA prices surged, a knock-on effect of the sulphur cost pressure that hit Indonesian HPAL nickel.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Formula-based PPA pass-through would shift input-cost risk to buyers and stabilise LFP CAM margins.

insights.claim: Benchmark flags that if LFP CAM producers' margins stay tight from elevated ferrous phosphate and PPA prices, LFP cathode prices may decouple from broader cathode pricing trends.
insights.speaker: Frederick Bloomfield
insights.so_what: A decoupled LFP price would break the usual co-movement across cathode chemistries.
insights.quote: LFP CAM prices may decouple from broader cathode pricing trends
insights.locator: What to look out for in Q4 2026

insights.claim: Benchmark forecasts lithium prices to rise in Q4 2026, with market participants expecting demand frontloading ahead of China's upcoming VAT rebate removal; lithium remains the key driver of all CAM chemistry prices.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: A policy-driven pull-forward could lift lithium and cathode prices briefly before the rebate ends.
insights.locator: The price of lithium chemicals continues

insights.claim: After steep cobalt declines and a bearish near-term Benchmark outlook, industry players are looking for cobalt price support to prevent further freefall in cobalt-containing cathode material.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Cobalt-heavy cathode stays under pressure unless cobalt finds a floor.
insights.locator: Furthermore, following the steep drops in cobalt
